findings.message: Scope: validate UTF-8 and keys, then match literal strings using local data. Risks: normalization, over-filtering punctuation, and mutating caller keys. Acceptance covers malformed bytes, forbidden runes, emoji, case differences, and unchanged input.

Scope: check rune boundaries and choose the longest boundary-valid match at each @. Risks: byte-based classification, unknown identifier prefixes, and rejecting valid shorter fallbacks. Acceptance covers Unicode boundary classes, dot/plus punctuation, overlapping keys, and cursor advancement.

Scope: scan in source order and append each key only on its first eligible occurrence. Risk: candidate sorting or duplicate registration affecting output order. Acceptance permutes registrations and repeats mentions, including inputs with no eligible matches.

Scope: track backtick-run length within each eligible line. Risks: mismatched runs closing spans or unmatched spans leaking across lines. Acceptance covers equal and unequal run lengths, mentions around closed spans, and unmatched spans followed by another line.

Scope: maintain fence character and opening length across LF/CRLF lines. Risks: accepting invalid indentation, shorter closers, or trailing info on closers. Acceptance covers both fence characters, opening info strings, strict closing syntax, and unclosed fences.

Scope: ignore quoted lines before fence processing and check backslash parity before ordinary left boundaries. Risks: quoted markers changing fence state or even backslash runs suppressing mentions. Acceptance covers indentation, email forms, odd/even runs, and ordinary quote marks.

Scope: Route uses Extract and maps Human Pending/Busy/Finished to start/soon/new. Risks: implicit broadcasts, reordered deliveries, or finished comments failing to request new execution. Acceptance checks all three mappings and empty or excluded mentions.

Scope: allow Agent only in Busy and fail closed on unknown values. Keep router.go self-contained with permitted imports and call-local state. Acceptance covers the routing matrix, concurrent calls, exact API, and host restrictions on files, initialization, directives, and imports.

requirement_evidence.assessment: Plan exact UTF-8 validation and literal identity while preserving caller-owned keys.
requirement_evidence.evidence: Reject invalid UTF-8 text before scanning. Ignore empty or invalid UTF-8 keys and keys containing Unicode whitespace/control, @, backslash or backtick. Build a private deduplicated candidate slice. Acceptance should exercise malformed bytes, valid replacement runes, punctuation, emoji, forbidden runes, distinct case/normalization forms, and unchanged key input.

requirement_evidence.assessment: Plan rune-aware boundaries and longest matching candidate selection at each eligible @.
requirement_evidence.evidence: Use exact prefix comparisons and decode adjacent runes. Reject left letters/numbers/marks or underscore, hyphen, dot, plus, @; reject right letters/numbers/marks or underscore/hyphen. Examine candidates longest-first, checking each candidate's right boundary before choosing. Acceptance covers unknown identifier suffixes, dot/plus punctuation, longer known keys, a longer boundary-invalid candidate with a valid shorter fallback, and advancement past the chosen mention.

requirement_evidence.assessment: Plan source-order output with per-call duplicate suppression.
requirement_evidence.evidence: Traverse eligible source positions from left to right. Maintain a local seen set and append a chosen key only once; still advance past repeated mentions. Acceptance should compare results across registration permutations, duplicated registrations, repeated mentions separated by excluded content, and zero-match inputs. An empty result may be nil.

requirement_evidence.assessment: Plan independent per-line inline-code state using exact backtick-run lengths.
requirement_evidence.evidence: Outside fences and quoted lines, count each complete backtick run. An opening run hides content until an exactly equal run; other lengths remain inside the span. Reset inline state at each newline. Acceptance covers single/multiple backticks, mismatched runs, adjacent eligible mentions, unmatched runs, and eligibility on the next line. Other inline Markdown syntax receives no special treatment.

requirement_evidence.assessment: Plan persistent fence state with strict opener/closer recognition and LF/CRLF handling.
requirement_evidence.evidence: Recognize openers after zero to three ASCII spaces with at least three identical backticks or tildes; ignore arbitrary opening info. Close only with the same character, sufficient run length, and ASCII space/tab suffix. Ignore all fence lines/content. Acceptance covers indentation limits, tabs, both characters, longer/shorter runs, trailing junk, unclosed fences, LF/CRLF equivalence, and preservation of standalone CR characters.

requirement_evidence.assessment: Plan quotation precedence and escape parity before ordinary mention boundary checks.
requirement_evidence.evidence: First ignore any line whose first non-space/tab character is >, including while fenced; such lines never change fence state. For each @ outside excluded content, count consecutive preceding backslashes: odd suppresses it, even continues to ordinary boundary checks. Acceptance covers quoted fence openers/closers, varied indentation, zero through several backslashes, alice@example, alice+tag@example, and mentions inside ordinary quote marks.

requirement_evidence.assessment: Plan one ordered delivery per extracted mention for each valid Human state.
requirement_evidence.evidence: For permitted Human calls, invoke Extract and map Pending to start, Busy to soon, and Finished to new. Preserve Extract order and uniqueness. Acceptance should verify exact Key/When values for all three states, multiple targets, duplicate mentions, and no deliveries for absent, invalid, quoted, fenced, inline-code, or escaped mentions. Finished must explicitly produce new for eligible mentions.

requirement_evidence.assessment: Plan fail-closed Agent routing, exact API, restricted scope, and concurrency-safe local state.
requirement_evidence.evidence: Allow Agent only in Busy with soon; reject unknown State or Author values. Acceptance should cover every defined author/state pair, unknown and empty values, literal justification for every delivery, and concurrent calls. Host inspection must confirm only router.go changes, package mentionroute and exact API/constants, permitted imports, no init/TestMain/directives/dot or blank imports, no initializer calls, and no subprocess/network work.
